name: fr-social-contributions
description: French social contributions for 2026, centred on the self-employed (travailleurs indépendants) who pay URSSAF: the 2026 social security ceiling (PASS EUR 48,060), the reformed single base (gross income less costs, then a 26% allowance) first used for the 2025 regularisation, the 2026 rates for artisans, commerçants and liberal professions (Cipav and non-Cipav), minimum and maximum contributions, provisional calls and regularisation, the first two years, Acre (now a quarter exemption from 2026), micro-entrepreneur rates on turnover (12.3%, 21.2%, 25.6%, 23.2%), CSG and CRDS on activity income and on capital income (10.6% CSG on most capital income: 2025 income assessed with income tax, and income taxed at source from 1 January 2026), payment dates and late surcharges, and a summary of salaried rates. Trigger on "cotisations URSSAF", "charges sociales indépendant", "micro-entrepreneur taux", "Acre", "CSG CRDS", "prélèvements sociaux", "Cipav", "régularisation URSSAF". Out of scope: payro
